floating_training_precision: BF16 autocast forward/backward, FP32 stored parameters and FP32 evaluation
quantization: all29 Conv/Linear W[-7,7] A[-7,7], STE learned scales, FP32 accumulation
frozen_batchnorm: running statistics frozen from floating checkpoint throughout QAT and hardware finetuning; affine parameters trainable

hardware_assumption.source: B CISA2020 Fig1b two-core window detector, 55nm schematic TT27C1.2V
hardware_assumption.voltage_mapping: V=raw/160; ADC inverse RNE(raw*255/192); raw above192 not clipped before mapping
hardware_assumption.held_model: deterministic bilinear CM/signed-d interpolation of baseline-subtracted HADC_P; outside grid clamp to edge and count; no fitted random distribution
hardware_assumption.state: P=current fresh sample, N=previous active sample held at prior985ps; prior returned code feeds prefix; N residual discarded after old sample already digitized; state extension beyond B test history assumed
hardware_assumption.decision: input-referred19/38mV step approximation; guard sweeps constrain intervals, not precise transition. Do not add HCAP error again to this decision
hardware_assumption.rail_policy: if either SA input outside0..1.2V, bypass detector and use full native ADC; explicit software completion assumption
hardware_assumption.fit_data: only B schematic data; no workload labels used
caveats: large-d residual extrapolation and arbitrary history not characterized
no PVT,MC,PEX or extra Gaussian noise
0..1.2V raw full-scale mapping assumed; native digital transfer unchanged

mapping: 128 rows x128 columns, 2-bit cells, four signed activation bits, W+7 offset digits with exact digital correction
ordering: independent reads parallel on CUDA; serial returned-code and held-value feedback within each read; reset across array/bit/token/reduction tile
selection: best validation accuracy then lowest CE; include epoch0; tests only after selection frozen
dataset_history: Same CIFAR-100 dataset has been evaluated previously in project; not a fresh blind benchmark. No external full-CIFAR-trained weights.

qat_extension.start: parent epoch20 model and AdamW moments

final_protocol.purpose: Final bounded WRN accuracy and SAR comparison matrix, no additional zero gating
final_protocol.initialization: same original W4A4 checkpoint for all7 training branches
final_protocol.optimizer: same AdamW1e-5 to1e-6 cosine schedule,20epochs; BN stats frozen, affine/scales trainable
final_protocol.branches: one matched ordinary native-ADC control plus6 SA/held-aware branches
final_protocol.selection: best validation accuracy then CE, including epoch0; both ranges and all skips reported; test only once after all7 selections frozen
final_protocol.test_history: Previously viewed project test subset; exploratory final matrix, not fresh blind evaluation
final_protocol.zero_gating: disabled for all data-dependent zeros; only unmapped padding columns excluded
final_protocol.detector_model: same deterministic B P-node985ps residual table, signed-d/CM bilinear edge clamp; same rolling reference assumptions
final_protocol.architecture_scope: same three conv layers, fixed mapped request count; partial SAR, no whole conversion skipping
final_protocol.no_additional_experiments: No automatic extension, hyperparameter search or extra network. Report unsuccessful branches too.
final_protocol.energy: report comparison count, valid SA calls, schematic subtotal budget only; no total-system net-energy claim
final_protocol.sparsity: record actual zeros and hypothetical gate opportunity diagnostically; no data gates affect conversion schedule
